+def gauge_fixed_logits(raw_logits, group_sizes, global_bias):
+    sizes = torch.as_tensor(group_sizes, dtype=torch.long, device=raw_logits.device)
+    ends = torch.cumsum(sizes, dim=0)
+    prefix = torch.cat((raw_logits.new_zeros(1), torch.cumsum(raw_logits, dim=0)))
+    starts = ends - sizes
+    means = (prefix[ends] - prefix[starts]) / sizes.to(raw_logits.dtype)
+    expanded_means = torch.repeat_interleave(means, sizes)
+    return raw_logits - expanded_means + global_bias

method_selection.citation: gauge-fixing rationale (per-user constant shifts leave the metric invariant); pairwise-consistency literature.
method_selection.why: The parent learning curve is entirely unusable, so an overfit or underfit diagnosis would be speculative. Gauge-fixed BCE is a cheap, unapplied, measured-win opportunity that fits the grouped ranking task, preserves the existing BPR term, and previously delivered +0.0026—large enough to potentially clear the 0.002 convergence threshold. It also avoids the excluded overfit and underfit families.

rejected.reason: It is promising and measured-win, but its observed +0.0015 gain is below the convergence epsilon and it is better tested after establishing a stable grouped-objective parent.

The lineage already tried the sequence/author-history direction, and the full composite is high-cost with fidelity and leakage-audit risks; prefer the cheaper independently measured objective correction first.
Its precondition is not met: this lineage does not yet contain at least two mechanism families measured above 0.6040, and ensembling should remain a closing move.

expected_delta_basis: The selected gauge-fixed-bce card reports a measured +0.0026 over a 0.6018-family parent in run_novel_r1 node_003.

method_selection.citation: teammate research (Aditya), independently verified; DeepFM (Guo et al. 2017); censored watch-time modeling (CWM, KDD'24)
method_selection.why: The learning curve is entirely unusable, so no dynamics-based treatment is justified. This diagnosis calls for the strongest evidence-ranked active opportunity: the full composite is materially different from the previously tried author-history base, adding causal session context, a censor-aware auxiliary head, and a predeclared 2-member mean-logit close. Independently verified results reach 0.606116, giving it a credible chance to exceed the 0.002 convergence threshold from the current lineage, although selection optimism means the honest expected result is nearer 0.6055-0.6060 if implemented at full fidelity.

rejected.reason: It is a strong untried measured-win direction, but its expected +0.0005 to +0.0015 gain is unlikely to clear the 0.002 threshold with the no-improvement streak already at two.
Its gate requires at least two mechanism families above 0.6040 in this run lineage; that condition is not currently established.
It was already attempted on this dataset and is measured-flat after six campaign attempts; it also conflicts with the excluded overfit family.

expected_delta_basis: The selected seq-deepfm-composite card reports independently verified two-member primary 0.606116 and agent-implemented package results around 0.6043-0.6048, versus the current lineage near 0.6032-0.6040.
